messages:
elin: quick preflight before we kick the quant canary — wanted to sync on what "must-have" signals we need to gate on. not just latency: quality + operational signals.
peter: lean list: degscore, hallucination-rate (rules), per-layer norm drift, and KV-cache mismatch count. also keep per-request seed so we can reproduce exact generations.
sam: + add token-repeat spikes and perplexity delta for last-200 tokens. those catch repeat-loop regressions fp8 sometimes introduces.
elin: good. thinking about how to compute degscore consistently across variants. should degscore be model-normalized or baseline-normalized?
peter: baseline-normalized seems better for rollout comparators: degscore_rel = (profile_score - baseline_score) / baseline_score. avoids penalizing naturally noisier prompts.
nora: ops question: do we want automatic guardrail in the router to fallback to INT8 if degscore_rel > 0.1 for 1% of requests in a 5m window? that's conservative.
elin: sounds reasonable. timeline for canary: 5% -> 25% -> 50% over 24h windows with automated checks at each step.
dev-bot: canary plan created: /infra/canaries/quant_v1.yaml. Includes watch windows and rollback actions; PR: #1124.
peter: telemetry: add a compact per-request metadata blob with fields: profile, quantized_layers (list), seed, ctx_len, runtime_kv_checksum. store as newline-delimited jsonl in S3.
sam: about kv_checksum: serialization format must be stable across runs. use SHA256 over serialized KV in deterministic order. log as hex.
infra-bot: cluster prep: reserved nodes g-pool-03 (v4) and g-pool-07 (a100) for 12h slot starting now. image tag: rwinf/serve:canary-2026-03-21.
elin: excellent. eval matrix: fp8, int8, 4bit, hybrid-attn-int8, hybrid-ffn-int8. 3 repeats each. seeds [7,77,777].
peter: also do 'shadow-hybrid' where we run FP8 but mirror output to INT8 offline to compute disagreement rates. no traffic routing changes.
mar: (note: mar is out but confirming) we'll need human judgment for borderline cases. recommend recruiting 25 raters for pairwise A/B on the top 500 divergent samples.
ora: cost question: logging full logits will explode storage. proposal: persist top-20 logits and the top-1 delta per token. compress gz.
elin: agreed. also keep headwise L2 norm snapshots for first 6 layers and last 6 layers every 128 tokens. helps triage headwise drift.
sam: one more test: run a random 1% of prompts with deterministic temp=0.0 to inspect greedy behavior differences. helps find subtle beam/entropy changes.
peter: rollout gating numbers: degscore_rel threshold = 0.10, hallucination_mult = 1.4 relative to baseline, repeat_spike_rate > 2x baseline. if any breach at a step, automatic rollback to previous cohort.
elin: logging path: s3://rwinf-telemetry/quant_canary/1760023456/. please ensure retention 90 days for faster debugging.
dev-bot: job templates pushed: /jobs/quant_canary/*.yaml. jobs will emit both metrics.csv and artifacts.zip with checksums.
infra-bot: note: hybrid-attn-int8 requires custom kernel; enabling may change p50 by ~5-8ms. include perf run for latency-only baseline.
mar: for human A/B UI: show full conversation, highlight hallucination candidates detected by rules, and ask raters: "Which reply is more helpful/accurate?" 3-level Likert.
elin: owners: elin (experiment lead), peter (metrics + analysis), sam (degradation heuristics), nora (ops & rollout), mar (human eval).
peter: small design choice: where to put per-layer quant metadata? prefer in a separate column in metrics.csv as pipe-delimited string (e.g. "L1:FP8|L2:INT8|..."). easier to parse.
elin: fine. also include a short textual note in the S3 manifest describing any model patch (tokenizer tweaks, patch id).
sam: do we want to try per-channel vs per-tensor quant for FFN first? that could change accuracy. let's include both for FFN in matrix: int8-per-channel, int8-per-tensor.
peter: good call. that expands runs but worth it. cut 4-bit runs if costs get too high, but capture at least 1 repeat.
elin: final action list: 1) infra-bot finalize nodes and image (done) 2) dev-bot create job PR (done) 3) sam implement degscore and repeat detector (in progress) 4) peter wire up metrics.csv schema + S3 manifest 5) mar spin up human eval thread. reconvene in ~18h after first automated pass.
infra-bot: first suite started. progress: 10% complete. logs: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/rwinf-telemetry/quant_canary/1760023456/run_01/logs.gz
elin: thanks — please slack the link to #eng-ml when the automated pass finishes.
mar: will do. :thumbsup:
peter: one more: snapshot the exact docker diff for the image (git commit + installed libs) in the manifest so we can reproduce kernels later.
elin: added to todo. good catch.
